title: Catalan basics
variety: Central Catalan (Barcelona), in the current spelling (2017 rules: soc, dona)
about: The most common words of written Catalan (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/ca/rank.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out.
